backend_contract.atomicity: per_journal_record_compare_and_set_on_revision_and_state; subject and external authority transactions remain separate
backend_contract.durability_guarantee: write PREPARED close_reopen persists; write APPLYING close_reopen persists; terminal persist failure is J10 nonterminal_after_terminal_persistence_failure

backend_contract.idempotency: journal_id unique; correlation lineage preserved; history not overwritten
